use React\Async;
use React\Promise;

function test_sign_in($exchange, $skipped_properties) {
    return Async\async(function () use ($exchange, $skipped_properties) {
        $method = 'signIn';
        if ($exchange->has[$method]) {
            Async\await($exchange->sign_in());
        }
        return true;
    }) ();
}
